cost per provider and model, every limit in its budgets

models.triage: the strongest open-vendor planning model, reasoning effort low
models.plan_and_draft: the same planning model, one call with the whole context
models.final_pass: the planning model, only when an action returned new facts or an injection is suspected
models.checker: an open-vendor model of another vendor than the drafter
models.research: the planning model at a higher effort, or an open-vendor model that wins on the replay set
models.judge: an open-vendor model of another vendor than the writers and the checkers
models.rule: every lane that reads what people wrote runs only on open-vendor models, its fallbacks included (prompt rule 6)

budget.stop_in_code: just under the key's limit, window month
budget.evals: judge_budget_usd and replay_budget_usd above 0 in the channel-agent declaration
